def compute (op : Operation) (a b : Word) : Word :=
  match op with
  | .shl => if b.toNat < 32 then a <<< b.toNat else 0
  | .shrU => if b.toNat < 32 then a >>> b.toNat else 0
  | .shrS => if b.toNat < 32 then a.sshiftRight b.toNat else if a.msb then 0xffffffff else 0
